purpose: Bind every P1 metric input field occurrence to exactly one semantic authority. This is a semantic authority map, not a physical-column map.
rules: Every (metric_code,input_field) pair in P1_METRIC_CATALOG.json appears exactly once.
Physical source columns may differ; adapter mapping_manifest must map them to the authority_field semantic name.
profile.* resolves only through the versioned Evaluation Profile registry using the exact Catalog parameter name.
P1-* input references resolve only to a published upstream metric output, never to a locally recomputed approximation.
When binding_kind=UPSTREAM_CONTRACT, the metric must declare authority_id in upstream_dependencies.
Reference-side semantic fields must resolve to a declared reference/event contract or CANONICAL_REFERENCE_NAVIGATION_V1; they may not fall back to sensor/track/fusion measured-state views.
Optional fields retain the Catalog question-mark marker and may not silently become required.

CANONICAL_AIRCRAFT_STATE_V1.scope: aircraft flight/control/energy state + authoritative Session Time attached to aircraft samples

CANONICAL_MISSION_SYSTEM_TRACK_V1.scope: track/identity state not otherwise owned by a frozen upstream contract

CANONICAL_TDL_MESSAGE_TRACK_V1.scope: TDL message/remote-track fields not otherwise owned by a frozen upstream contract

CANONICAL_FUSION_TRACK_V1.scope: fused-track state not otherwise owned by a frozen upstream contract

CANONICAL_REFERENCE_NAVIGATION_V1.scope: reference navigation/identity/state/time-quality fields when no more specific frozen upstream contract is declared

EVALUATION_PROFILE_V1.scope: exact profile.<parameter> names frozen by Catalog

METRIC_OUTPUT_V1.scope: explicit upstream P1 metric output references

CONTRACT_TIME_TRANSFORM_V1.scope: contract-defined derived/event authority; only valid when declared by the metric

CONTRACT_REFERENCE_MATCH_QUALITY_PROFILE.scope: contract-defined derived/event authority; only valid when declared by the metric
